66490522.name: dom-italian-1-716526 (designed)
66490522.text: It had been raining for three days. The kind of rain that doesn't wash anything clean. I lit a cigarette, watched the neon bleed into the gutter, and waited for a phone that wasn't going to ring.
66490522.instruct: A man in his forties with a deep, gravely voice. American english with an italian accent. Slow, weary, quiet.
